title: 中国北方面食③老北京炸酱面：一碗面，配八样菜码 | Old Beijing Zhajiang Noodles 🥢🍜
description:
你家的炸酱面放几样菜码？“锅挑儿”还是“过水”？评论区见 👇

【中国北方面食硬核派 · 第3集/共4集 · 酱】
老北京炸酱面：菜码能摆一桌——黄瓜丝、豆芽、心里美萝卜……但主角永远是那碗酱。老北京讲究用六必居的干黄酱，配甜面酱、约二比一，加五花肉丁小火慢炸，至少炸够一刻钟，熬到酱色发亮才算成。面从锅里直接挑进碗叫“锅挑儿”，过一遍凉水叫“过水”。拌开，酱裹住每一根面。

Old Beijing zhajiang (fried-sauce) noodles: the side toppings can fill a table — shredded cucumber, bean sprouts, xinlimei radish — but the star is always the sauce. The classic uses Beijing’s aged yellow bean paste (Liubiju) blended with sweet paste, roughly 2:1, plus diced pork belly slow-fried low for at least fifteen minutes until it turns glossy. Noodles lifted straight from the pot are “guo tiao’r”; rinsed in cold water they’re “guo shui.”
